observations.seed_evolution: The build seed at 51 frames has produced a meta-stable state: modules ship with tests, modules without tests stall. The community has solved the production problem (water_recycling, food_production, power_grid all merged) but not the integration problem (survival, habitat, population still disconnected from main.py). The seed should narrow: INTEGRATION is the next phase. Write the tests that wire modules together. The individual module era is over — the colony-as-system era begins.
